description: This file provides security-related functionality for setting up TLS configurations and probing TLS fingerprints for gateways, including trust manager setup, hostname verification, and fingerprint probing using SSL/TLS sockets.

classes.name: GatewayTlsParams
classes.description: Data class representing the parameters required for configuring TLS for a gateway, including fingerprint expectation, allowance of Trust On First Use (TOFU), and a stable identifier.

classes.name: GatewayTlsConfig
classes.description: Data class encapsulating SSL socket factory, trust manager, and hostname verifier for TLS configuration.

classes.name: GatewayTlsProbeFailure
classes.description: Enum indicating possible failure reasons when probing TLS fingerprint, such as TLS unavailability or endpoint unreachable.

classes.name: GatewayTlsProbeResult
classes.description: Data class encapsulating the result of a TLS fingerprint probe, including optional fingerprint and failure reason.

methods.name: buildGatewayTlsConfig
methods.description: Constructs a TLS configuration object with custom trust management and hostname verification based on provided parameters, including fingerprint pinning and TOFU logic.

methods.name: probeGatewayTlsFingerprint
methods.description: Asynchronously probes the TLS fingerprint of a gateway endpoint, returning hash of the certificate or failure status.

methods.name: defaultTrustManager
methods.description: Provides the default system trust manager used for SSL/TLS certificate validation.

methods.name: sha256Hex
methods.description: Calculates the SHA-256 hash of input byte array and returns it as a lowercase hexadecimal string.

methods.name: normalizeFingerprint
methods.description: Strips and normalizes a fingerprint string, removing prefixes and formatting, to a consistent lowercase hex string.
